newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling eases in unmatched market.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling eases in unmatched market.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling eased further on Tuesday against the dollar in an unmatched market, commercial bank dealers said.
Against the dollar, Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.51 compared to 54.46 on Monday while against the pound, it was posted at a mean of 90.81 from 90.62.
"There's thin selling interest from exporters and we're meeting large orders from importers," one commercial bank dealer said.
"We're selling dollars at 54.90," a dealer said.
